name: Heatmap
description: Renders a canvas-based kernel-density heatmap of the host layer's point features, with configurable radius, blur, gradient and an optional weight property. Toggles alongside its host as a sublayer.

components.name: Enabled
components.description: Draws a density heatmap of this layer's point features as a toggleable sublayer.

components.name: Initial Visibility
components.description: Whether the heatmap is shown when the host layer is first turned on.

components.name: Radius (px)
components.description: Radius in screen pixels of each point's influence. Default 25.

components.name: Blur (px)
components.description: Blur in screen pixels applied to each point. Default 15.

components.name: Weight Property
components.description: Optional dot.notated feature property whose numeric value weights each point. Unset weights all points equally.

components.name: Max Intensity
components.description: Value that saturates the gradient. Leave blank to use the maximum weight found in the data (or 1 when unweighted).

components.name: Min Opacity
components.description: Minimum alpha (0-1) a single point contributes. Default 0.05.

components.name: Gradient
components.description: Color ramp as JSON {"0.4":"blue","1":"red"} or shorthand 0.4:blue,0.6:cyan,0.7:lime,0.8:yellow,1:red (the default).
